tasks.short: Plan and conduct balanced learning activities

steps.what: Plan activities balancing instruction, demonstration, work time and opportunities to investigate

loop.purpose: Suggest a balanced activity sequence for teacher-supplied goals
loop.input: Goals, verified access constraints, time and available resources
loop.output: Draft activity sequence with explicit assumptions
loop.check: Teacher checks learning purpose, accessibility, safety, timing and opportunities for student questions against actual needs
loop.stop: One revision; unsuitable support assumptions or unsafe activities return to manual planning
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cannot judge the instructional fit of varied activities

steps.what: Conduct activities and adapt instruction to student questions and responses

tasks.design: Use native {LMS} activity templates before an optional bounded planning loop. The teacher checks access and instructional fit, and retains all live activity delivery and adaptation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Balancing activities for a particular group requires repeated planning.
tasks.enabler_now: Lesson tools can draft activities from a stated learning goal.
tasks.still_hard: A generic activity may be unsuitable for a student's access or support needs.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the plan to actual students and their responses.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft planning where suitable suggestions survive review.

reach.learn: Activity purpose and individual support constraints

evidence.claim: Snappet can draft a class activity for a stated lesson goal; the digest does not establish special-education suitability.
The special-education activity-planning saving is an unmeasured scenario after teacher adaptation.

assumptions: Boundary is activity planning and delivery, excluding formal course objectives and separate staff scheduling. Concurrent live teaching is allocated here once rather than added to another instruction task.
Teacher produces goal, time, materials and verified individual access constraints within s1's18 retained hours; no complete structured pupil profile is assumed.
Missing constraints require manual clarification; every activity receives teacher review and all live instruction remains70 hours.
Test native reusable plans first; use only a permitted planning environment without unnecessary pupil details.
unknowns: Planning effort and range of access needs
research_questions: Do suggested activities save planning time after accessibility and instructional-fit corrections?

already_counted.description: Supply planning constraints and check proposed activities

incremental.description: Maintain planning structure and review recurring unsuitable suggestions

approvals.approved_version: Exact activity sequence, resources, time and access assumptions; edits require renewed teacher review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gross12 less3 upkeep =9 net E1. High needs reusable activity suggestions; low covers extensive adaptation or already efficient planning.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare computers, audio-visual aids and other presentation equipment and materials
Use equipment and materials to supplement presentations and respond to students

tasks.design: Retain physical setup and responsive use of teaching aids, including existing {LMS} content. No new saving is attributed to equipment already used in the lesson.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment must work for the actual presentation and students.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing teaching equipment supports the unchanged work.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining access when equipment or student needs change.
tasks.human_edge: Notice whether the aid helps understanding and adapt its use.
tasks.altitude: Equipment setup and presentation support remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Access requirements and basic fault reporting

evidence.claim: Physical setup and use of existing teaching equipment remain fully counted.

assumptions: Boundary is equipment setup and use, excluding content creation. If use coincides with instruction, allocate that live time once.
Teacher checks equipment and access needs during retained s1; no structured equipment-ready flag is assumed.
No new system configuration or incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Available aids and classroom access needs
research_questions: Which equipment problems most often interrupt accessible presentation?

already_counted.description: Set up and use presentation aids

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; existing equipment use is not new automation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interpret curriculum guidelines and requirements for the course and students
Prepare draft objectives and outlines following the verified curriculum requirements

loop.purpose: Draft a course outline from teacher-interpreted requirements
loop.input: Verified curriculum passages, course scope, learner needs and intended outcomes
loop.output: Draft objectives and outline with requirement links
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, level, coverage and realistic student access; each objective must match the cited requirement rather than merely carry its code
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported outcomes or altered requirements return to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: A template supplies headings but cannot express course-specific objectives

steps.what: Check and approve the final objectives and course outline

tasks.design: Start with native {DOCS} course templates and a verified curriculum brief. A bounded loop may draft wording and sequence, while the teacher retains interpretation, coverage checks and final approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course requirements must be restated as coherent objectives and an outline.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting can use the teacher's verified requirement interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently aligned objective can be unrealistic or change the intended learning.
tasks.human_edge: Judge educational purpose, level and access.
tasks.altitude: Less initial outline wording, with curriculum judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: A verified-brief drafting loop may reduce outline wording effort; no measured special-education course-outline result is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary is course objectives and outline preparation, excluding individual education programs, lesson activities and live instruction.
Teacher produces curriculum passages, version, course scope, intended level and verified access constraints in s1's full40 hours; no existing structured curriculum mapping is assumed.
Missing requirements require manual clarification before drafting. Draft correction21 hours and final review25 hours remain counted.
Test native templates first and use minimal pupil information.
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting preserve requirement meaning and realistic learner access after correction time?

incremental.description: Maintain outline structure and review drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact objectives, outline and curriculum source version; edits require renewed teacher review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gross14 less4 upkeep =10 net E1. High needs settled interpretation and repeated outline wording; low covers major redesign or extensive correction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with staff and schedule lessons

steps.what: Confer with staff members to plan lessons following approved curricula
Schedule lessons and confirm staff, rooms and support availability

tasks.design: Retain collaborative lesson planning and use native shared {CALENDAR} availability to reduce repeated slot checking. The teacher confirms support and resource suitability before accepting the schedule.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff and room availability may be checked repeatedly through messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared calendars can show available times without a model.
tasks.still_hard: An empty slot does not guarantee suitable support for the lesson.
tasks.human_edge: Agree instructional intent and check practical support.
tasks.altitude: Less scheduling coordination, with collaborative planning unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native shared-calendar availability may reduce repeated scheduling checks; the estimate is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is joint staff planning and scheduling, excluding individual activity-plan writing. Shared planning time must be assigned once rather than added to activity preparation.

Teacher produces lesson duration, staff, resource and support constraints during s1's full70 hours. Staff and room owners retain existing calendar maintenance; additional coordination exceptions are counted below.
Missing availability is confirmed manually within s2's15 retained hours; no complete structured support-availability feed is assumed.
Test native calendar configuration first; no judgement-based staff allocation is automated.
research_questions: Does shared availability reduce scheduling time after support and room suitability checks?

already_counted.description: Collaborative lesson planning and constraint capture
Confirm missing availability and final schedule

incremental.description: Resolve availability exceptions and maintain shared-calendar use

approvals.approved_version: Exact lesson time, staff, room and support arrangements; changes require renewed teacher confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gross15 less3 upkeep =12 net E1. High needs repeated manual slot checks; low covers already shared calendars or frequently changing support.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce suitable first-draft preparation and repeated scheduling checks while preserving teaching and collaborative judgement.
reach: Coordinate accessible lessons with assistants and school administrators
role.ambitious_version: A teacher with less repetitive preparation when reviewed suggestions fit the actual class.
